nodes.name: sifu.py
nodes.summary: Defines the SIFU (Sequence Into Features Unified) network, a PyTorch MLP that maps flattened dynamics history sequences to a feature vector plus estimated drone parameters (mass and thrust coefficient). Used as one of the selectable policy networks in the sousvide control stack.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dict-in/dict-out forward signature and slices nn.Sequential (self.networks[:-1]) so the penultimate activations double as a runtime feature vector while the final layer supplies the training-time parameter regression head.

nodes.name: SIFU
nodes.summary: BaseNet subclass implementing a configurable fully connected MLP over dynamics history sequences, exposing both an intermediate feature vector and a drone-parameter regression output.

nodes.name: SIFU.__init__
nodes.summary: Builds the MLP by reading input/output sizes from the parent BaseNet and stacking Linear/ReLU/Dropout blocks for each configured hidden size, capped by a final linear parameter head.

nodes.name: SIFU.forward
nodes.summary: Flattens the dynamics input tensor, runs it through all but the last layer to produce the feature vector, then applies the final layer to obtain parameter estimates, returning both in a dictionary.
